newsitem.title: GUATEMALA: Car robbers shoot European emissary in Guatemala.
newsitem.headline: Car robbers shoot European emissary in Guatemala.

text.p: A 50-year-old French citizen was shot twice in a car robbery outside the European Community's Guatemala office on Monday, hospital officials and co-workers said.

Pierre Bernardberoy was shot in the arm by two men on a Guatemala City street as he attempted to hand over the keys to a rented car, Byron Cifuentes, an administrator for the European Community Guatemala delegation, told Reuters.
Bernardberoy was in intensive care and his condition was stable Monday night, said Carmen Medida of Aurora Hospital in Guatemala City.
Bernardberoy arrived in the country March 22 as co-director of a four-year project funded by the European Community, said Carlos Morales, another administrator for the delegation.

Bernardberoy was returning to the office when he was approached by the robbers. The men became nervous and shot him before escaping with the car, Cifuentes said. Both bullets struck him in the arm, one passing through and grazing his chest, Cifuentes said.
